dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: G1 owns the post-authority action-execution gain, the collection module owns histories and raw persistence, and scripts only compose public owners.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The collector receives a typed approved protocol and public environment factory; the environment step boundary receives only nominal first Actions.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Fault transformation, protocol admission, canonical provenance, quota, rollback, and raw validation remain outside scripts and backend-private APIs.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Thirty real Actions precede the first row; done or Command drift discards the pending transaction, allocates a new rollout identity, and repeats warmup.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The route is isolated to one G1 fault owner, one collection owner, one approved config, two composition scripts, exports, and focused tests.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline tests and static checks are reported separately from actual MuJoCo collection, Stage 1 training, calibration efficacy, and policy quality.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Independent tests cover nominal-to-authority-to-gain ordering, warmup, rollback, quotas, frozen policy, atomic persistence, provenance mutation, and dataset sealing.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Rows bind nominal State and Action histories, Planner Intent, six-Action chunk, gain target, diagnostic executed Action, rollout/split/seed, source, protocol and resolved task identities.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Collection constructs no optimizer, runs policy inference only, and verifies all source policy parameters and buffers are bitwise unchanged.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Raw publication is atomic and strict loading independently recomputes protocol and resolved task digests before dataset publication.

evidence.observation: The artifact carries exact protocol bytes and canonical resolved task/backend material; all persistence boundaries independently recompute and compare both digests.
Replacing either digest with another legal lowercase SHA is rejected, including the prepare path before dataset save, while the correct artifact round-trips.

findings.preserved_behavior: The approved gain mapping, row schema, 192-row quota, and dataset target construction are unchanged.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Persist the exact identity material and recompute both digests in the collection owner before accepting or publishing the artifact.
required_tests: Keep valid-format protocol and task digest mutation regressions and the correct round-trip case.

residual_risks: Real MuJoCo materialization, server checkpoint compatibility and actual raw or dataset collection remain unproved.
